# 693. Binary Number with Alternating Bits

## Solution 1 (time O(log(n)), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def hasAlternatingBits(self, n):
        """
        :type n: int
        :rtype: bool
        """
        prev_bit = None
        while n:
            cur_bit = n % 2
            if prev_bit == cur_bit:
                return False
            prev_bit = cur_bit
            n //= 2
        return True
```
